fuente.titulo: Pope to American Jewish Committee: ‘We reject together all forms of hatred’

titular: Pope Leo XIV meets Jewish leaders, rejects hatred
bajada: Addressing AJC delegation, pope calls for unity, dignity and religious freedom
caption: Pope Leo XIV met with a delegation from the American Jewish Committee, calling for cooperation to promote human dignity, defend religious freedom and reject all forms of religious and ethnic hatred. Source: Vatican News, Oct 22, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A formal Vatican reception hall where a religious leader in white papal attire greets a seated delegation; the figure appears at medium distance, side view, placed in the upper right third, with the left and central areas of the room left open and uncluttered.
